sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.11262 Of 2023
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 7 to quash the proceedings in Crime No.937 of 2023 on the file of the Petbasheerabad Police Station, Cyberbad District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 387 and 506 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard Sri C. Pratap Reddy, learned senior counsel representing Sri N. Manohar, learned counsel on record for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.
Perused the record.
3.
A private complaint was filed by the de facto complainant alleging that certain document was fabricated and the petitioners allegedly had taken advantage of the said document in the year 2003.

4. Learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that there are pending civil disputes in respect of the said property and further, the de facto complainant had already disposed of the property.
He would further submit that the de facto complainant has no locus standi to file the criminal complaint against the petitioners herein.

5. Keeping in view that the complaint lodged by the de facto complainant is outcome of civil disputes, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the police to conclude the investigation looking into the background of civil disputes in respect of the property and conclude the investigation without taking coercive steps against the petitioners.
Needless to say that the proceedings under Section 91(1) of Cr.P.C cannot be invoked against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 7 during the course of investigation.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed off.
Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
K.SURENDER, J Date: 16.11.2023 gvl K.V. Narsimha Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97839770/
